summary: Election dispute over discrepancy in vote count; Form 46 vs. presiding officer's oral statement; allegation of ballot tampering and vote cancellation; RTI request for Presiding Officer's diary and Matpatra Lekha denied due to non-availability; Sub-Divisional Magistrate ordered recount; High Court reversed, appeal filed; issue of free and fair election, integrity of electoral process, and judicial oversight in recount matters; democracy and constitutional values emphasized.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; recount of votes at Booths 43, 44, and 45 directed as per law.
